blocks.text: Recipient profiles help your organization detect and manage sensitive data being sent to specific people. They are part of Zscaler's Data Loss Prevention (DLP) tools to use in policy rules that detect and take action on sensitive data across multiple channels. To learn more, see About Data Loss Prevention, About Data at Rest Scanning DLP, and About Outbound Email Policy.
Recipient profiles provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Help your organization detect and manage sensitive data being sent to specific people.
Manage individual users and groups that you want to include or exclude from outbound email policy rules.
Easily edit recipient profiles to update all policy rules where the profiles are used.

blocks.text: On the Recipient Profiles page (Data Security > Email DLP > Recipient Profiles), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Modify the table and its columns.
Show filtering options for the table.
Select filtering options for the table.
View a list of all recipient profiles created for your organization. For recipient profiles, you can see:
Profile Name: The name of the recipient profiles. You can sort this column.
Recipient Emails: The recipient emails included in each profile. You can sort this column.
Description: The description or notes of the recipient profile. You can sort this column.
Edit, duplicate, or delete a recipient profile.
